_prune_note_03-09-2026: The --prune that cleared ARCC and EGCH also deleted the DOCUMENTATION keys inside scope_widened and tightened — added, date, removed, what, why — because it treats every key in a group as an entry. Those keys record WHY those groups exist, and losing them would leave two groups whose reason nobody could recover. Restored by hand and recorded here. A prune should distinguish an ENTRY from the note that explains the group holding it; until it does, check a prune's diff rather than trusting its count.

scope_widened.what: The gate first read only the delivered PDF. It now reads the delivered WORKBOOK too, after AMOC's document came back clean while its workbook computed a 45/20/20/15 blend into three cells labelled WEIGHTED CENTRAL.
scope_widened.why_this_is_not_a_widened_ratchet: The entries added here were ALREADY outstanding; they were invisible because the gate was not looking at the artefact that carried them. A ratchet may only shorten against a FIXED population, and this records the population changing so that the two are not confused. No existing entry was removed to make room, and AMOC came OFF because it was fixed.

tightened.what: The retirement-marker window was 260 characters and is now the SAME SENTENCE, and the blend pattern now catches a label the page layout splits around its figures ("WEIGHTED  the four, weighted  4.93 9.91 16.73  100%  CENTRAL").
tightened.why: Both were false negatives on AMOC. Its Table 1 caption asserts the CURRENT construction — 'the bear and bull columns of the weighted row are WEIGHTED with the same 45/20/20/15 weights as the base column' — and the very next sentence describes what a PREVIOUS edition did. The window swept the second in and waived the first; the split table row was never matched at all. I pruned AMOC off this ratchet on that green and told the principal its document was clean. It was not.
